Alex: Partner GTM sync — quick alignment for marketplace go-live next Tue 4/12. Need press asset owners, landing page final, SI integration notes, and HW partner logistics.
Priya: I can own press assets + embargo timing. Question: are we locked to 4/12 or soft window?
Sam: Ops confirmed infra can scale for expected onboarding. We'll need partner SKU mapping from partners by EOD Fri.
Elaine: @Ben can you confirm hardware partner logo/boilerplate signoff? Legal to review by Monday.
Ben: Pinged HW partner PM (DellEdge) re logos; they said yes but require attribution line. I'll drop copy.
LegalBot: Legal review task created — ticket #PL-4321. ETA Mon 10am PT.
Priya: Press plan: short blog, joint announcement, and 2 partner quotes. Draft blog headline idea:
```
Redwood Inference arrives on CloudPartner Marketplace — High-performance LLM inference at scale
```
Thoughts?
Sam: We should include live demo link on landing + SI integration guide. I pushed staging build to https://staging.redwood.inference/marketplace-partner
Alex: Cool. Quick checklist: press draft (Priya), landing hero + demo (UX + Sam), partner logos (Ben), SI runbook (Samira)
Samira: I'll own SI runbook + onboarding checklist. Will need API keys for demo; @eng-infra can you prod?
Ben: Logos: got PNG/SVG. I'll add attribution: 'Provided by DellEdge' per partner. Will upload to assets bucket by 5pm.
Priya: Embargo: set for Tue 4/12 16:00 PT. Everyone keep edits in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123 (edit access: priya@redwood.com and partners)
Alex: Decision points: landing CTA (signup vs contact sales). Suggest signup for PLG leads, contact sales for enterprise. Vote?
Elaine: Legal prefers 'contact sales' for joint announcements with partner logos? but ok to have signup with TOS modal.
Ben: :thumbsup: go with signup + modal.
Sam: We should A/B test CTA copy during first 72h.
Priya: I will finalize press release language by Mon EOD. Need partner quotes — Ben please confirm partner rep.
Ben: DellEdge: quote approved by Jordan Lee. I'll paste it in doc.
Samira: For SI runbook, I need sample tenant provisioning script. Snippet:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/tenants" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant_name":"partner-demo","plan":"marketplace-starter"}'
```
Alex: If no blockers, we do dry run on Mon 4/11 11:00 PT. Can everyone make it?
Priya: yes
Sam: yes
Ben: yes
Elaine: can do 11:30 if needed, prefer 11:00
Samira: yes, will share runbook draft beforehand
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded: marketplace-partner v1.3 — 3790000032
Alex: Great—I'll send calendar invite for 4/11 11:00 PT and add the dry run checklist. Any last-minute concerns?
Priya: None from press side.
Ben: Nothing from partner ops.
Sam: Will monitor infra during launch window.
LegalBot: Noted. Filing final review once copy is in.
Alex: Thanks all. Closing thread — we'll reconvene in the dry run. :rocket:
